design_overview: A modern, elegant flower delivery app designed with a soft, botanical aesthetic. The interface prioritizes visual product discovery through high-quality flower imagery, intuitive navigation, and a seamless checkout experience. The design balances emotional appeal with functional clarity, using gentle colors, ample whitespace, and clear visual hierarchy to guide users from browsing to purchase completion.

typography.font_family: Inter, SF Pro Display, Roboto, sans-serif
typography.body_font: Inter, SF Pro Text, Roboto, sans-serif

screens.name: Home Screen
screens.purpose: Primary landing screen showcasing featured flowers, categories, and quick access to main features

key_components.name: Top Header Bar
key_components.styling: White background with subtle shadow, contains app logo on left and notification bell icon on right, height 60px
key_components.interaction: Bell icon navigates to notifications screen

key_components.name: Search Bar
key_components.styling: Light gray background (#F5F5F5), rounded corners (12px), search icon on left, placeholder text 'Search flowers...', height 48px, margin 16px

key_components.name: Featured Banner
key_components.styling: Full-width card with gradient overlay (primary to accent), rounded corners (16px), height 180px, contains heading 'Spring Collection' and CTA button
key_components.interaction: Tapping navigates to featured collection detail screen

key_components.name: Category Section Header
key_components.styling: Bold text 'Shop by Category', 20px font size, left-aligned, margin-top 24px
key_components.interaction: Non-interactive label

key_components.name: Category Horizontal Scroll
key_components.styling: Horizontal scrollable list of 6 category cards, each 100px wide with rounded image, category name below, spacing 12px
key_components.interaction: Tapping any category card navigates to category-filtered catalog screen

key_components.name: Popular Flowers Header
key_components.styling: Bold text 'Popular Flowers', 20px font size, left-aligned with 'View All' link on right, margin-top 24px
key_components.interaction: View All link navigates to full catalog

key_components.name: Popular Flowers Grid
key_components.styling: 2-column grid of flower product cards, each card has image (square, rounded 12px), flower name, price, and heart icon, white background with shadow
key_components.interaction: Tapping card navigates to flower detail screen, heart icon toggles favorite status

key_components.name: Quick Add Button
key_components.styling: Small circular button with plus icon, positioned bottom-right of each product card, primary color background, white icon
key_components.interaction: Adds flower to cart with default quantity, shows brief success toast

key_components.name: Bottom Navigation Bar

screens.user_flow: Entry point for most users. From here users can search, browse categories, view popular flowers, or navigate to other main sections via bottom nav. Tapping products leads to detail screens.

screens.name: Flower Detail Screen
screens.purpose: Display comprehensive information about a selected flower including images, description, pricing, and purchase options

key_components.name: Back Button Header
key_components.styling: Transparent background overlaying image, back arrow on left, share icon on right, height 56px
key_components.interaction: Back arrow returns to previous screen, share icon opens native share sheet

key_components.name: Hero Image Carousel
key_components.styling: Full-width image carousel, height 360px, swipeable, pagination dots at bottom, rounded bottom corners (24px)

key_components.name: Favorite Button
key_components.styling: Floating circular button with heart icon, positioned top-right over image, white background with shadow
key_components.interaction: Toggles favorite status, animates heart fill

key_components.name: Product Info Card
key_components.styling: White card with rounded top corners (24px), padding 20px, contains flower name (24px bold), category tag, rating stars, and price (28px bold primary color)
key_components.interaction: Non-interactive information display

key_components.name: Stock Indicator
key_components.styling: Small pill badge showing 'In Stock' with green background or 'Low Stock' with warning color, positioned below price
key_components.interaction: Non-interactive status indicator

key_components.name: Description Section
key_components.styling: Text block with 'Description' header (16px bold), followed by product description (14px regular), line-height 1.6, margin-top 16px
key_components.interaction: Expandable text with 'Read More' if content exceeds 3 lines

key_components.name: Quantity Selector
key_components.styling: Horizontal control with minus button, quantity number (center), plus button, light gray border, rounded (8px), height 44px
key_components.interaction: Plus/minus buttons increment/decrement quantity, minimum 1

key_components.name: Delivery Date Selector
key_components.styling: Date picker input with calendar icon, placeholder 'Select delivery date', light border, rounded (8px), margin-top 12px
key_components.interaction: Opens date picker modal, restricts to future dates only

key_components.name: Add to Cart Button
key_components.styling: Full-width primary button, height 56px, rounded (12px), white text 'Add to Cart - $XX.XX', fixed at bottom with padding 16px
key_components.interaction: Adds selected quantity to cart, shows success animation, navigates to cart screen

key_components.name: Similar Flowers Section
key_components.styling: Horizontal scrollable list with header 'You May Also Like', shows 5 similar product cards, margin-top 24px

screens.user_flow: Reached from home screen, category screen, or search results. Users review product details, select quantity and delivery date, then add to cart or return to browsing.

screens.name: Shopping Cart Screen
screens.purpose: Review selected items, modify quantities, view total cost, and proceed to checkout

key_components.name: Header with Title
key_components.styling: White background, 'My Cart' title centered (20px bold), back arrow on left, height 56px, bottom border
key_components.interaction: Back arrow returns to previous screen

key_components.name: Cart Items List
key_components.styling: Vertical list of cart item cards, each card shows flower thumbnail (80x80px), name, price, quantity selector, and trash icon, white background with dividers
key_components.interaction: Quantity selector updates cart, trash icon removes item with confirmation

key_components.name: Empty Cart State
key_components.styling: Centered illustration with text 'Your cart is empty' and 'Start Shopping' button, shown when cart has no items
key_components.interaction: Start Shopping button navigates to home screen

key_components.name: Promo Code Input
key_components.styling: Text input with placeholder 'Enter promo code', 'Apply' button on right, light border, rounded (8px), margin-top 16px
key_components.interaction: Apply button validates code and updates total if valid

key_components.name: Order Summary Card
key_components.styling: White card with light border, shows Subtotal, Delivery Fee, Discount (if applied), and Total in bold, padding 16px, rounded (12px)
key_components.interaction: Non-interactive summary display

key_components.name: Delivery Info Banner
key_components.styling: Light green background banner with text 'Free delivery on orders over $50', icon on left, margin 12px
key_components.interaction: Non-interactive informational banner

key_components.name: Continue Shopping Link
key_components.styling: Text link styled in secondary color, 'Continue Shopping', positioned below cart items
key_components.interaction: Navigates back to home screen

key_components.name: Checkout Button
key_components.styling: Full-width primary button, height 56px, rounded (12px), white text 'Proceed to Checkout', fixed at bottom with shadow
key_components.interaction: Navigates to checkout screen with delivery and payment forms

key_components.name: Saved Items Section
key_components.styling: Collapsible section with header 'Saved for Later (3)', shows horizontal scroll of saved items, margin-top 24px
key_components.interaction: Tapping item moves it back to cart, expandable/collapsible section

screens.user_flow: Accessed from bottom nav or after adding items. Users review cart, adjust quantities, apply promo codes, then proceed to checkout or continue shopping.

key_components.name: Delivery Address Card

key_components.name: Saved Addresses Selector
key_components.styling: Dropdown or modal showing saved addresses with radio buttons, 'Add New Address' option at bottom, light background

key_components.name: Delivery Date Picker
key_components.styling: Date input with calendar icon, shows selected date or placeholder 'Select delivery date', rounded (8px), margin-top 12px

key_components.name: Delivery Notes Input
key_components.styling: Multi-line text area, placeholder 'Special delivery instructions (optional)', light border, rounded (8px), height 80px
key_components.interaction: Optional text input for delivery instructions

key_components.name: Payment Method Card

key_components.name: Order Summary Sidebar
key_components.styling: Sticky card showing order items count, subtotal, delivery fee, total, light background, rounded top corners (16px)

key_components.name: Terms Checkbox

key_components.name: Place Order Button
key_components.styling: Full-width primary button, height 56px, rounded (12px), white text 'Place Order - $XX.XX', disabled state when form incomplete

responsive_design: Mobile-first approach with breakpoints at 375px (small phones), 768px (tablets), and 1024px (desktop). On tablets, product grids expand to 3-4 columns, navigation moves to side drawer. Desktop view shows persistent sidebar navigation, larger product cards, and multi-column layouts. All touch targets maintain minimum 44x44px size. Images use responsive sizing with srcset for optimal loading.
accessibility: WCAG 2.1 AA compliant with minimum contrast ratio 4.5:1 for text, 3:1 for UI components. All interactive elements have clear focus states with 2px primary color outline. Screen reader labels on all icons and images. Semantic HTML structure. Keyboard navigation support. Dynamic text sizing support up to 200%. Color is never the only indicator of state. Error messages are descriptive and associated with inputs.
animations: Subtle micro-interactions throughout: button press scales to 0.95 with 150ms ease-out, page transitions slide horizontally 300ms ease-in-out, modal slides up from bottom 250ms ease-out, heart favorite animates with scale and color change 200ms, loading states use skeleton screens with shimmer effect, toast notifications slide down 200ms and fade out 150ms, pull-to-refresh uses native spring animation, quantity changes animate number with fade 100ms.
icons: Consistent icon set using outlined style from home, search, user, settings, bell, bookmark, heart, filter, plus, edit, trash, share. Icons are 24px by default, 20px in compact contexts, 32px for primary actions. All icons have 2px stroke weight for visual consistency. Icons use currentColor to inherit text color for easy theming.
